annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and finite-sum formalization of the forward-error half of Lemma 4.2

assumptions: The update error obeys the paper's componentwise relative bound with nonnegative u.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P08 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P08 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p08_t1_lemma_4_2_forward_error_bound {n : Nat} (Ainv : Fin n -> Fin n -> Real) ... : forall i, abs (xNext i - x i) <= (1+u) * p08AbsAction Ainv q i + u * abs (x i)
formal_statement.plain_language: The rounded refined iterate satisfies the componentwise forward-error bound in the second conclusion of Lemma 4.2.

informal_proof: Rewrite xNext-x as Ainv*q+h, apply the frozen componentwise absolute matrix-action theorem to Ainv*q, and combine it with the update-rounding hypothesis and the scalar triangle inequality.
informal_statement: The forward-error conclusion of Lemma 4.2, with the absolute inverse action expanded as a finite sum.
paper_version: published journal version; volume 35, issue 151, July 1980, printed pages 817-832

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: The frozen MatrixAlgebra object supplies the only nontrivial matrix estimate directly; the remaining work is the paper's update substitution and elementary scalar arithmetic.

source_locations.anchor: Lemma 4.2, second displayed inequality and its proof

tier_rationale: NumStability.abs_matMulVec_le in NumStability/Analysis/MatrixAlgebra.lean directly gives the absolute inverse-action term in Lemma 4.2; only the update equation, its supplied rounding bound, and scalar normalization are needed.
